purpose: Whole-project stage 0-6 dataset and evaluation asset inventory for offline preparation before any GPU rental window.
scope_guardrails: No Jev API output, JEV-27B weights, JEV-27B-VL weights, or forbidden Jev labels are admitted.

source_requirements.original_design: docs/Lite-OmniJev设计方案-最终版.html lines extracted with HTMLParser; stage 1-6 source table and stage inputs were used as the controlling scope.

status_definitions.downloadable_verified: Official source, immutable revision or fixed upstream version, license is clear enough for offline mirroring; still requires per-file hash verification after download.
status_definitions.downloadable_with_root_coordination: Same as downloadable_verified, but one or more files exceed 100 MB or total payload is large.
status_definitions.physical_staging_ready_with_obligations: The bytes may be mirrored for source audit after root coordination and attribution/notice tracking; this does not admit them to training or release.
status_definitions.benchmark_eval_staging_pending_original_: Benchmark metadata is available, but original publisher terms must be checked before evaluation media is mirrored or used for score claims.
status_definitions.training_release_decision_pending: Physical staging may be possible, but model-training, model-release, data-card, attribution, share-alike, or copyleft implications require a later project decision.
status_definitions.license_blocked: Terms, upstream component license, or commercial/training rights are unclear or restricted enough that even physical staging is not yet recommended.
status_definitions.account_or_form_blocked: Download requires account, form, external acceptance, or maintainer-mediated access.
status_definitions.provenance_blocked: Aggregate source or label lineage is not enough to prove original labels/media can enter training.
status_definitions.externally_controlled: Must be prepared or read by an isolated gate or external owner; development agents must not read contents.
status_definitions.future_generated: Not downloadable now; generated by project pipelines after prerequisite stages pass.
status_definitions.research_download_authorized_training_de: Specific original research-only download agreement accepted by user; physical download/CPU proof still required and original media excluded from commercial training.
